headline: Building web products that actually work.
name: Olufemi Gbolahan  Abiodun
role: full-stack web developer based in Lagos, Nigeria
subtext: I design and build fast, modern web applications for businesses and startups.
about_title: I help businesses build web products that perform.
about_paragraph_1: I'm a full-stack developer with 3 years of hands-on experience building web applications that are fast, clean, and built to last. I've worked with clients across Lagos and remotely, turning ideas into shipped products.
niche_statement: I specialise in building Django + React applications for logistics, e-commerce, and operations-heavy businesses in Nigeria.
about_paragraph_2: My background spans both frontend (React, HTML/CSS, JavaScript) and backend (Python, Django, SQL), which means I can take a project from wireframe to deployment without handing it off.
